lines.en: I move fast. Faster than I look.
Two steps, one hop. Counting?
Slime trails behind my feet.
Knockback-proof. I don't back up.
I swell as I walk.

lines.zh: 地上黏糊糊的全是我的痕迹。
lines.en: The ground is sticky where I've been.
My eyes are too swollen to see much.
Count two hops and I jump.
No detours. Straight at you.
This skin could split any moment.

lines.zh: 我身上滴下来的东西会烧。
lines.en: What drips off me will burn.
I stop only when I'm close.
Even standing, I twitch.
Two blisters rise on me.
Slime is running down.
My mouth is too gummed to open.
This place is too dry.
I lift a hand; strings stretch.
I'm counting how long is left.

lines.zh: 我不出汗，我流别的东西。
lines.en: I don't sweat. Something else comes out.
Under this skin, all gas.
The ground under me softened.
Nothing on your face yet.
I look at you and measure distance.
Wiped it off? It won't come off.
Standing that close is brave.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，已经不像脸了。
lines.en: This face barely is a face.
Is that cloth in your hand wet?
I know you came last time.

lines.zh: 你身上有一点我的味道。
lines.en: You already smell a little of me.
I stare at you and count two.

lines.zh: 你还不知道黏上会怎样。
lines.en: You don't yet know what the slime does.
The skin split. Gas is leaking.
That made me more urgent.
I don't retreat. Knockback-proof.
The wound is bubbling.
That spot you hit is going to burst.
What I leak is hot.
I twitched, then steadied.
That moved my schedule up.
My mouth is still sealed.
One hit won't stop this.

lines.zh: 你举的是吃的？我嘴粘住了。
lines.en: Food? My mouth is sealed shut.
I smell it. I don't want it.

lines.zh: 那东西掉进我身上就毁了。
lines.en: Drop it on me and it's ruined.
Put it far away. As far as you can.
Come closer and I want to jump.
There's no room left inside.
Don't trade that for my life.
I reach for it and can't hold.
Don't shake; it'll splash.
I'm stickier than that.
Bump me and you're coated.
I don't get knocked back. You do.
Slime rubbed onto your sleeve.
Don't touch it. It doesn't wash off.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，就粘住了。
lines.en: We collide and stick.
You pushed. I didn't budge.
I'm slick. Can't be grabbed.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝要吃进这个。
lines.en: Your armor gaps will take this in.
Only water will get it off.

lines.zh: 你退开时还连着一根丝。
lines.en: A string of it still links us.
I'm not built for this now.
Two sticky things make a stickier mess.
I forgot how this works.
Stand back. It splashes.
Together we're just one lump.
It smells awful. I won't lie.
Afterwards a layer sticks to the ground.

lines.zh: 这不叫繁殖，叫糊在一起。
lines.en: Not breeding. Just gummed together.
It swells even more than me.
We only do this on rainy days.
I pick it up and it's stuck.

lines.zh: 手上的东西拿不下来了。
lines.en: I can't put it down now.

lines.zh: 地上有什么我都裹起来。
lines.en: I wrap up whatever's on the ground.
This iron is smeared with slime.

lines.zh: 我捡它的时候拉出一根丝。
lines.en: A string stretches as I lift it.
It's glued to my palm.
Taking it won't help. It's all slime.
I press the thing into my chest.
I'll keep this grass to wipe my hands.
Don't pick up what you dropped.
I count to two, then jump.
You're slime-free. Perfect.
Two hops first, so you see.
After the hops you can't dodge.
The target is within two blocks.
I'm especially fast right now.

lines.zh: 你能躲过炸，躲不过黏液。
lines.en: You may dodge the blast, not the slime.
All of this, coming at you.
You'd want water. You didn't bring any.

lines.zh: 你一动，我两下就跳过去。
lines.en: One move from you and I'm two hops away.
I hopped left. You didn't move.
Your soles are getting sticky.
Two blocks left. Enough.
I'm already swollen full.
First you get slimed. Then we talk.

lines.zh: 我跳到左边，再跳到右边。
lines.en: I hop left, then right.
The slime links behind me in a chain.
Three blocks left.
You're at the wall. I'm in no hurry.
My body is swelling.
You raise the shield over your face.
I hop around to your side.

lines.zh: 地上的黏液让你慢下来。
lines.en: The slime underfoot slows you.
One more hop and I'm close enough.
You're counting my hops, aren't you?

lines.zh: 我的皮绷得发白，快裂了。
lines.en: My hide stretches pale, about to split.
You already have some on you.
I hopped behind you.
There's slime on that stone.

lines.zh: 你每转一次，我离你更近。
lines.en: Every turn you take, I'm a little closer.

lines.zh: 你绕来绕去，我闻着黏液找。
lines.en: You keep circling; I follow the slime trail.
My legs are shaking. Not much left.

lines.zh: 你一抬手我就知道要打。
lines.en: I know when you'll swing by your arm.
These two hops are for you.
Slime to the face first.
I grab you and start to swell.

lines.zh: 炸开的时候你也在里面。
lines.en: When it blows, you're inside.
All of this, for you.
Your eyes are gummed shut.
One bump and my skin splits.

lines.zh: 现在你身上那点会烧起来。
lines.en: Now that bit on you will burn.
I'm not hitting you. I'm hugging you.
Don't struggle. It sticks more.
That sends you far back.

lines.zh: 我的手指卡在你护甲上。
lines.en: My fingers are caught in your armor.
My hand finally reached you.
That's the last one.
You're stuck where you stood.

lines.zh: 你护甲上那点会烧很久。
lines.en: That bit on your armor will burn a while.
I rise out of the slime.
The hole in the ground is still wet.
I splashed a ring on landing.
There was a dead man here before.
Two test hops to start.
I'm not dry yet.
I heard you come near.
I dragged a trail of slime here.
This body is all gas.
Don't light anything nearby.
The ground rumbled as I came out.
I opened my eyes and saw you.

lines.zh: 我从一堆黏液里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a pile of slime.
The smell here is familiar.

lines.zh: 火一沾上，我全身都烧起来。
lines.en: Fire touched me and I burned all over.

lines.zh: 落地时我摔得黏了一地。
lines.en: I hit the ground and smeared slime everywhere.
Water washed the slime off and I went soft.
A blast outside, and I burst inside too.

lines.zh: 箭插进来，黏液顺着箭杆淌。
lines.en: The arrow pierced me and slime ran down the shaft.

lines.zh: 药水的光把我的气压住了。
lines.en: Potion light pressed my gas down.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，只有一肚子气。
lines.en: I don't eat. Only a belly of gas.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上全是焦泡。
lines.en: Lightning struck and blisters scorched across me.

lines.zh: 虚空里我最后炸了一次。
lines.en: In the void I burst one last time.
